'''Carleon''' was a [[High Lord]] of [[Tear]]. 

== Appearance ==
He had a thick body.

== Activities ==
Along with High Lords [[Tedosian]], [[Sunamon]] and [[Meilan]], he attended a meeting with [[Rand al'Thor]] to discuss new policies that Rand was implementing after the [[Stone of Tear]] fell. Rand noticed he and Tedosian were avoiding looking at eachother.{{ref/book|4|8}} He was numbered among those Lords disloyal to Rand. [[Thomdril Merrilin]] forged and placed a letter where the High Lord [[Tedosian]] found it, linking Carleon to Tedosian's wife, [[Alteima]].{{ref/book|4|4}} He was killed by Tedosian in a "hunting accident."{{ref/book|4|17}}
